answer: Each jetty post holds three marble tokens per epoch. A sponsor spends one token and locks a 70-credit marble bond to vouch a newcomer, who files a tide reading in time. Auditors replay the tide log: a fake reading or a shared jetty log burns bond and token; two burns cost the post. Filings cost 45: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000, lock 70,000, need 334 sponsors, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-vouch rings burn too. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the bond.
